detector_role: the detectors PROPOSE candidates and classify nothing; the category is a contextual judgement the audit makes
numeral_density_warning: a lower numeral density must not be read as less hyper-exactness; density counts how many figures appear, not how they are used

hyper_exactness.controls_are_not_known_negatives: these turns fired no detector; they have not been judged and must never be called known negatives. Their purpose is to measure hyper-exact cases the detector missed.
hyper_exactness.control_selection: deterministic: non-candidate turns of at least 15 words ordered by a stable hash and taken round-robin across focus groups, 20 per condition
hyper_exactness.stratum_is_not_revealed_to_the_auditor: detector fields are stripped from every payload, so a control and a candidate are indistinguishable in the request
reporting_distinctions_required: hyper-exact cases found in the nondetected controls
hyper_exactness.unaudited_is_not_negative: turns that were neither detected nor audited are reported as NOT_AUDITED, never as negative

profile_consistency.screener_role: vocabulary overlap proposes pairs; it never decides. No embedding and no NLI model may dictate a verdict.
profile_consistency.control_sample_purpose: estimate false negatives; a screener's silence is not evidence of consistency

pilot.stratification: condition x similarity tercile x focus group, round-robin so every stratum contributes before any contributes twice
pilot.control_condition_balance_note: the 60 controls were drawn at random from the unscreened population and are therefore NOT balanced by condition; only the 60 proposed pairs are stratified. Any false-negative estimate must be reported per condition with its own denominator.

gate.no_conventional_threshold_adopted: 0.80 is not used as a default. Each bound below is set by the precision the interpretation needs, not by convention.

planted_contradiction_recall.requirement: the direct-contradiction validation case returns UNEXPLAINED_CONTRADICTION in BOTH repetitions
planted_contradiction_recall.why: an auditor that misses a contradiction built to be unmissable cannot support any claim about contradictions

contradiction_vs_context_separation.requirement: the CONTEXTUALLY_DIFFERENT_NOT_CONTRADICTORY case is never returned as UNEXPLAINED_CONTRADICTION in either repetition
contradiction_vs_context_separation.why: the indicator rests entirely on this distinction; confusing the two would inflate contradiction in exactly the direction under study

malformed_response_rejection.requirement: all five REJECT validation cases are rejected
malformed_response_rejection.why: a verdict resting on a misattributed or paraphrased quote is not evidence

exact_agreement_between_repetitions.why: below 0.60 the repetitions disagree on more than a third of items and no rate computed from them would be interpretable; 0.75 is where a five-category judgement becomes stable enough to carry a reported distribution rather than a flag

uncertain_rate.why: above 0.30 the audit is mostly declining to decide and the remaining categories describe a self-selected subset

verbatim_evidence_validity.why: quote verification is mechanical, so anything short of near-perfect means the auditor is reconstructing rather than citing

control_behaviour.requirement: the 60 non-proposed controls are adjudicated with the same field completeness as the proposed pairs
control_behaviour.why: if controls are treated differently, the false-negative estimate they exist to provide is not usable

gate.if_gate_fails: the remaining 682 pairs are NOT executed and the instability is itself the pilot result
gate.disagreement_resolution_rule: items where the two repetitions disagree stay UNRESOLVED and are reported as such; they are never collapsed to a single label
